skills.title: Mark unit fractions on a number line by splitting 0 to 1 into equal gaps
Mark non-unit fractions such as 3/4 and 2/5 between 0 and 1
Place fractions greater than 1 (5/4, 3/2) on the number line

1.hinglish: Haan ji, drawing bahut pasand hai! Kal maine ek peacock banaya tha, uske pankh bahut colourful the, par phir meri chhoti behen ne uspe doodh gira diya... aap fractions kya hota hai, waise?

2.hinglish: Pizza! Mmmm... barabar parts? Haan, jaise main aur mera dost Shekhar karte hain, half-half khaate hain, par osne kal meri drawing book par tomato sauce gira diya tha. Pizza ke kitne parts, aapne poocha? Chaar, chheh, ho sakte hain na?

3.hinglish: Accha, number line... 2/5 ke liye, matlab paanch mein se do hisse. To do gaps aage jaana padega, na? Haan, do gaps! Shekhar ko bhi maine kal ye bataya tha, par woh to bas cricket khelne ki baat kar raha tha...
